# dbaas_instances (Data Source)

List authorized DBaaS instances across every page and, when zone is omitted, every configured zone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `engine` (String) Exact catalog engine ID filter. Omit to read all engines.
- `zone` (String) Exact configured DBaaS zone name or UUID. Use the computed UUID for subsequent operations.

### Read-Only

- `instances` (Attributes List) All authorized instances, ordered by zone UUID and instance ID. A failure in any page fails the read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))

<a id="nestedatt--instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) instance creation time
- `deleted_at` (String) terminal deletion time
- `desired_generation` (Number) latest desired-state generation
- `engine` (String) catalog engine ID
- `id` (String) DBaaS instance ID
- `name` (String) instance name
- `observed_generation` (Number) generation reached by reconciliation
- `plan` (String) catalog plan ID
- `recovery_until` (String) last instant when retained recovery may be requested
- `source_cidrs` (List of String) source IPv4 CIDRs allowed to reach the database
- `state` (String) instance state
- `storage_gib` (Number) persistent storage per data-bearing node in GiB
- `topology` (String) catalog topology ID
- `updated_at` (String) instance update time
- `version` (String) catalog engine version
- `zone_id` (String) CloudStack zone ID
- `zone_name` (String) Installed CloudStack zone name
